metas.name: ★ 8.9 · 2002 · Firefly
metas.description: A renegade crew aboard a small spacecraft tries to survive as they travel the unknown parts of the galaxy and evade warring factions as well as authority agents out to get them.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2005 · Doctor Who
metas.description: Continuing on from Doctor Who (1963), this revival follows the further adventures of the Doctor and their companions as they encounter various alien threats and save civilizations on different planets and time periods.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2008 · Fringe
metas.description: An F.B.I. agent is forced to work with an institutionalized scientist and his son in order to rationalize a brewing storm of unexplained phenomena.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2009 · Better Off Ted
metas.description: In an amoral science-based company, a manager tries to keep control of his scientists while being pressured by his shrewd boss.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2009 · Dollhouse
metas.description: A top secret organization erases the identities of attractive young people, turning them into blank "dolls" ready for imprints of temporary identities they need to fulfill assignments for clients.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2009 · Flashforward
metas.description: A special FBI task force investigates after every person on Earth simultaneously blacks out and awakens with nothing but a short vision of their future.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2009 · Stargate Universe
metas.description: Trapped on an Ancient spaceship billions of light-years from home, a group of soldiers and civilians struggle to survive and find their way back to Earth.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2004 · The 4400
metas.description: As the reappearance of 4,400 missing persons on a single day confounds the global community, federal agents on the case slowly discover the ways in which the victims have been changed.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2009 · Caprica
metas.description: Two families, the Graystones and the Adamas, live together on a peaceful planet known as Caprica, where a startling breakthrough in artificial intelligence brings about unforeseen consequences.
